final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT mt.Name AS name, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS avg_price, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM s1) SELECT s1.name, s1.avg_price, s1.avg_ratio, s1.avg_ratio / NULLIF(s2.overall, 0) AS ratio_to_overall FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.overall IS NOT NULL
